title: Careers in Film Summit: Halloween and Horror Genre Edition
org: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
summary: Day-long virtual summit with working Academy members and film professionals on careers in motion pictures. Four panels cover animation, horror film music, production roles and above-the-line positions. Registration opens October 12 and is required for the Zoom link; first come, first served.
